title: Krawtchouk generating polynomial
statement: For a sign vector $x\in\{-1,1\}^{n}$, define its Krawtchouk generating polynomial by $K_x(X)=\prod_{i=1}^{n}\bigl(1+\sigma(x_i)X\bigr)\in\mathbb{R}[X]$, where $\sigma(1)=1$ and $\sigma(-1)=-1$.
